description: Manages external and internal links associated with various business entities such as projects, partners, or contracts. These links can point to documents, websites, or other relevant resources.

endpoints.name: GetLinks
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of links associated with a specific entity (e.g., Project, Partner, Contract) and its unique identifier. Supports optional pagination for managing large result sets.

entity.description: The type of entity the links are associated with (e.g., 'Project', 'Partner', 'Contract').

entityId.description: The unique identifier of the specific entity instance.

parameters.description: Pagination parameters including page number, page size, and optional sorting criteria.

example_uses: Get all links for a project with ID 123.
Retrieve the first 10 links associated with partner ID 456.
Find all document links related to contract ID 789, sorted by creation date.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to fetch all links related to a particular business entity (e.g., a specific project, partner, or contract) given its type and ID, and you may want to paginate the results.

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new link entry in the system, associating it with a specified entity.

req.description: The request body containing the details for the new link, including its URL, description, and the entity it's associated with.

example_uses: Create a new link for a project, pointing to its external documentation.
Add a new resource link to a partner's profile.
Register a new internal document link for a contract.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to add a new link to the system, connecting it to a specific business entity.

endpoints.name: Update
endpoints.description: Updates an existing link's details based on its unique identifier.

req.description: The request body containing the updated details for the link, including its ID, new URL, description, or associated entity.

example_uses: Update the URL of an existing link.
Modify the description of a link associated with a project.
Change the entity type or ID that a specific link is associated with.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to modify the properties of an existing link record in the system.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.description: Deletes a link from the system using its unique identifier.

id.description: The unique identifier of the link to be deleted.

example_uses: Remove an outdated or incorrect link from the system.
Permanently delete a specific link record.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to permanently remove a link from the system when it is no longer needed.
